Publish the package to the LOGOS registry.

Packages the project as a tarball and uploads it to the specified registry. Requires authentication via `largo login`.

# Pre-flight Checks

Before publishing, the command verifies: - The entry point exists - No uncommitted git changes (unless `--allow-dirty`) - Valid authentication token

# Example

```bash largo publish              # Publish to default registry largo publish --dry-run    # Validate without uploading ```

Usage: largo publish [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --registry <REGISTRY>
          Registry URL. Defaults to `registry.logicaffeine.com`

      --dry-run
          Perform all validation without actually uploading. Useful for testing the publish process

      --allow-dirty
          Allow publishing with uncommitted git changes. By default, publishing requires a clean working directory

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo publish --dry-run
  largo publish
  largo publish --allow-dirty
